newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM reiterates income tax cut to end in April.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM reiterates income tax cut to end in April.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto reiterated on Wednesday that the government will not continue special income tax cuts in the fiscal year starting on April 1.
Hashimoto told a session of parliament's Lower House that a continuation of the special income tax cuts in the next fiscal year would aggravate the nation's fiscal deficit.
"A continuation of the special tax will only increase issues of deficit-covering bonds and thus boost fiscal deficits," Hashimoto said.
He also said the disposal of problem loans held at Japan's financial institutions is proceeding smoothly.
